gesture toward the door: Without saying a word, the angry manager gestured toward the door, telling me to leave his office.
生氣的經理一句話也沒說，就比向門口，要我離開他的辦公室。
gesture for silence: The teacher raised her hand to gesture for silence before announcing the test results to the class.
老師舉起手示意安靜，然後向全班宣布考試成績。
a gesture of goodwill: As a gesture of goodwill, the hotel gave us a free dinner because our room was not ready on time.
因為我們的房間沒有準時準備好，飯店免費招待我們一頓晚餐作為善意的表示。
glance at one's watch: During the boring meeting, he kept glancing at his watch, hoping that it would end soon.
在無聊的會議中，他一直瞥一眼手錶，希望會議快點結束。
glance through a report: I only had time to glance through a report on the train, so I missed some important details.
我只有時間在火車上瀏覽報告，所以漏掉了一些重要細節。
at first glance: The math problem looked easy at first glance, but it took me almost an hour to solve it.
這道數學題乍看之下很簡單，但我花了將近一個小時才解出來。
glare at someone: The old lady turned around to glare at the boys who were talking loudly in the movie theater.
老太太轉過身去，怒視那些在電影院裡大聲說話的男孩。
the sun glares: On summer afternoons, the sun glares so brightly off the white walls that I have to wear sunglasses.
夏天下午，陽光照在白牆上刺眼得讓我不得不戴上太陽眼鏡。
the glare of publicity: After winning the gold medal, the shy athlete found it hard to live in the glare of publicity every day.
贏得金牌後，這位害羞的運動員發現每天活在媒體聚焦之下很難受。
catch a glimpse of: Fans waited outside the hotel for hours, hoping to catch a glimpse of the famous singer.
歌迷在飯店外等了好幾個小時，希望能瞥見那位知名歌手。
glimpse the future: The robot exhibit at the science museum let the kids glimpse the future of everyday life.
科學博物館的機器人展讓孩子們窺見未來日常生活的樣貌。
glimpse a figure: Through the thick fog, I could only glimpse a figure walking slowly toward our house.
透過濃霧，我只能瞥見一個人影慢慢朝我們家走來。
glow with pride: When her son received the award on stage, the mother's face began to glow with pride.
當她兒子在台上領獎時，這位母親因自豪而容光煥發。
glow with health: After a month of hiking and eating fresh food in the mountains, she seemed to glow with health.
在山上健行並吃新鮮食物一個月後，她看起來紅光滿面。
the screen glows: In the dark bedroom, the screen glows softly as my sister reads her messages late at night.
在漆黑的臥室裡，我姊姊深夜看訊息時，螢幕柔和地發光。
a warm glow: The candles on the table gave the small room a warm glow that made everyone feel relaxed.
桌上的蠟燭讓小房間充滿溫暖光芒，讓每個人都感到放鬆。
govern a country: It takes more than good speeches to govern a country; leaders must also make wise decisions.
治理國家需要的不只是精彩的演講，領導人還必須做出明智的決定。
be governed by rules: Every club at our school is governed by rules that the students themselves voted on.
我們學校的每個社團都受學生自己投票通過的規則支配。
govern one's behavior: Good values should govern your behavior even when nobody is watching you.
即使沒有人在看，良好的價值觀也應該約束你的行為。
governing principles: Honesty and respect are the governing principles of our school, and every student is expected to follow them.
誠實和尊重是我們學校的指導原則，每位學生都應該遵守。
grab attention: A good title can grab attention quickly and make readers want to continue reading the article.
好的標題能迅速吸引注意，讓讀者想繼續讀下去。
grab a bite: We only have twenty minutes before the movie starts, so let's grab a bite at the noodle shop.
電影開演前我們只有二十分鐘，所以我們去麵店隨便吃點東西吧。
grab the opportunity: When the company offered him a chance to work in Tokyo, he decided to grab the opportunity right away.
公司提供他到東京工作的機會時，他決定馬上抓住機會。
grab the headlines: The singer's surprise wedding managed to grab the headlines in every newspaper across the country.
那位歌手的閃電婚禮搶占了全國各大報的頭條。
grab a seat: Please grab a seat anywhere you like; the meeting will start in about five minutes.
請隨便找個位子坐，會議大約五分鐘後開始。
up for grabs: Three free concert tickets are up for grabs for the first students who answer the quiz correctly.
三張免費演唱會門票人人有機會，先答對測驗的學生就能拿到。
grace the occasion: The famous actor agreed to grace the occasion and give a short speech at our school's anniversary party.
那位知名演員答應蒞臨盛會，在我們學校的週年慶派對上發表簡短演說。
grace the cover: The young tennis star will grace the cover of next month's sports magazine after her big win.
這位年輕網球明星大勝後，將登上下個月運動雜誌的封面。
grace someone with one's presence: Our boss rarely comes to team parties, but tonight he graced us with his presence for an hour.
我們老闆很少參加團隊聚會，但今晚他大駕光臨，待了一個小時。
fall from grace: The famous singer's fall from grace began when people discovered that he had lied about his past.
那位知名歌手在人們發現他對自己過去說謊後就開始失寵了。
